title: South African municipal boundaries
publisher: OCHA ROSEA / South African Municipal Demarcation Board; simplified by geoBoundaries
license: CC BY 3.0 IGO (original source); CC BY 4.0 (geoBoundaries project)
suggestedAttribution: Municipal boundaries: geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0); original source OCHA ROSEA / South African Municipal Demarcation Board (CC BY 3.0 IGO), representative2020 boundaries. Simplified for display. Municipality codes joined to the October2026 Treasury directory.
normalization: Geometry source name matched exactly after case, punctuation and Unicode normalization to HDX source name; duplicate Emalahleni names disambiguated by the published HDX centre point falling inside one polygon. HDX *_name1 municipality codes then joined exactly to Treasury directory municipality codes. No fuzzy matching or invented codes.
displayNote: Historical 2020 representative boundaries (source created2018), matched by municipality code to the October2026 directory. Names shown from the current directory; sourceName and vintage retained. Boundaries do not assert a current legal demarcation.
layerNote: ADM2 contains44 districts and8metros. ADM3 contains205locals and8metros. The8metro shapes occur at both levels; do not count or aggregate them twice. District and local polygons intentionally overlap. Recommended separate level selector.
precisionNote: geoBoundaries simplified visualization geometry; rounded6decimaldegrees. Not cadastral or survey geometry.
